item.title: ARC Raiders Getting an Anti-Cheat Update in the Coming Weeks; Will Address "Out of Map" Glitch
item.description: The out of map glitch in ARC Raiders will be addressed alongside other cheat-related issues as the game's anti-cheat is getting updated.

item.title: The Real Face of a VTuber is coming to Steam on January 13th
item.description: "Lilien Games and WhisperGames are today very happy to announce that The Real Face of a VTuber is coming to Steam on January 13th." - Lilien Games and WhisperGames.

item.title: Ustwo Games is weaning itself off Apple Arcade and Netflix amid strategy shifts
item.description: CEO Maria Sayans says the London studio is going PC first after Monument Valley 3 fell victim to Netflixs shifting games strategy.

item.title: Phasmophobia dev Kinetic Games launches indie publishing label
item.description: Kinetic Games boss Daniel Knight said he wants to provide the sort of support he needed at the beginning of his development journey.

item.title: After it beat Valve to market with its Steam Deck dock, Jsaux now has its sights on Steam Machine
item.description: Jsaux reveals its Steam Machine plans alongside Nordic faceplate stickers.

item.title: Aphelion composed by Amine Bouhafa; PS5 physical edition announced
item.description: The soundtrack for cinematic science-fiction third-person action adventure game Aphelion will be composed by Cesar award-winning French-Tunisian composer Amine Bouhafa, developer DONT NOD announced. A physical edition of the game will also be distributed by Maximum Entertainment across North America, Europe, and Australia.

item.title: Steam Detective Fest 2026 Kicks Off January 12
item.description: Steam Detective Fest 2026 runs January 1219, featuring mystery and detective games like Disco Elysium, Return of the Obra Dinn, and more.

item.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl Radiation, Revelation, Redemption |GLG
item.description: Step into the irradiated wilderness of S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl, where every shadow hides danger, and every choice shapes destiny. This is not just another post-apocalyptic shooter; its a living, breathing Zone that demands survival instincts, moral decisions, and a willingness to embrace the unknown.

item.title: CWA Canada vows to fight Ubisoft Halifax closure, defend workers
item.description: CWA Canada will pursue every legal recourse to protect our members at Ubisoft Halifax after the company announced today that it is shutting down the operation just three weeks after workers voted to unionize.

item.title: New Details On Final Fantasy VII Remake Part 3 Coming "Soon", Minigames To Remain A Core Part
item.description: New details on Final Fantasy VII Remake Part 3 will arrive "soon", and minigames are set to remain a core focus for the development team.
